verdict.rationale: Shortcut's pricing page says you can create additional Workspaces for sandboxing, which is the product's own way to separate test work from production data. That is a single line of evidence, and nothing documents how API or MCP access is scoped per workspace, how test data is seeded, or whether agents can be safely pointed at a sandbox workspace. missing for 10: dedicated sandbox environment documentation, per-workspace API/MCP token isolation details, test-data seeding or reset, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Create additional Workspaces for Sandboxing, to protect sensitive information
